description: This is a shell script used for automating end-to-end testing and setup tasks for a Windows Parallels VM, including managing snapshots, installing/upgrading components, starting servers, and performing onboard and verification steps in a Windows environment.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints info messages to stdout.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages to stderr.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Resolves and selects a snapshot based on a fuzzy matching hint.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Determines the host IP address to use for guest communication.

methods.name: is_host_port_free
methods.description: Checks if a specific port on local machine is free.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Finds an available port on local machine.

methods.name: resolve_host_port
methods.description: Resolves the port to use, either default or a free one.

methods.name: guest_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the guest VM.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout on the host.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Runs a PowerShell script inside the guest VM.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Runs a PowerShell script inside the guest VM with polling for completion.

methods.name: guest_run_openclaw
methods.description: Runs an openclaw command inside the guest VM.

methods.name: ensure_vm_running_for_retry
methods.description: Ensures the VM is running, resuming or starting it if necessary.

methods.name: run_windows_retry
methods.description: Retries executing a command inside the guest VM with backoff.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot by ID and manages power state.

methods.name: verify_windows_user_ready
methods.description: Checks if Windows user environment inside guest is ready.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Waits until VM reaches a desired status.

methods.name: wait_for_guest_ready
methods.description: Waits until guest environment signals readiness.

methods.name: phase_log_path
methods.description: Builds path for logs for specific phases.

methods.name: show_log_excerpt
methods.description: Outputs last lines of log file for debugging.

methods.name: phase_run
methods.description: Executes a phase of setup or verification with timeout and logging.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Extracts last version string from logs.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Writes a JSON summary of the run status.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Resolves latest version info from npm registry if not overridden.

methods.name: resolve_mingit_download
methods.description: Determines the latest MinGit asset download URL.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Gets current build commit hash.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent builds.

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Releases build lock.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Builds dist if current build info doesn't match current HEAD.

methods.name: ensure_guest_git
methods.description: Ensures Git is installed inside the guest VM.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tgz package of main build, optionally from target package spec.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Checks if the built package contains expected version info.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts HTTP server to serve tgz files.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Runs Windows commands to install latest release via provided URL.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Downloads and installs the main tgz into the guest VM.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Verifies that openclaw --version output contains expected substring.

methods.name: write_onboard_runner_script
methods.description: Writes PowerShell script for onboard process inside guest.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Performs onboard process via PowerShell inside guest using API key.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Checks gateway status inside guest.

methods.name: run_gateway_daemon_action
methods.description: Controls gateway daemon (start/stop/restart) via PowerShell inside guest.

methods.name: restart_gateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway daemon.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the gateway daemon.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Shows gateway status, with compatibility for different gateway versions.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Performs a turn of the agent to verify functionality.

methods.name: capture_latest_ref_failure
methods.description: Performs onboard and checks if latest release ref-mode onboard passes.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Executes the sequence for a 'fresh' mode run, including snapshot restore, install, verify, onboard, and agent turn.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Executes the sequence for an 'upgrade' mode run, including snapshot restore, install latest, verify, onboard, and agent turn.
